title: Slavic NLP 2027
about: Call for papers for the Slavic NLP 2027 workshop, co-located with EACL 2027 in Athens. Direct paper submissions are due 9 January 2027; shared task system papers 13 January; ARR commitments 16 January. The workshop is planned for the week of 9-14 March 2027.
requirements: Long papers in two-column ACL format: up to eight pages of content plus two pages of references
Papers reviewed by ACL Rolling Review (October 2026 cycle or earlier) can be committed

upskill.name: Natural Language Processing (NLP) II
why: "Natural language processing (Slavic languages)" → "Multilingual and cross-lingual NLP: low-resource languages, mBERT, XLM-R"
skill "Computational linguistics" → "Text summarisation, sentiment analysis, named entity recognition"
